title: ECHA committees advance universal PFAS restriction: fluoropolymers and PFAS surfactants in electronics scoped with transition periods
summary: The RAC and SEAC committees progressed their opinions on the proposed REACH restriction of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). Uses in electrical and electronic equipment including PTFE coatings and fluoropolymer gaskets are covered with proposed transition periods of 5 to 12 years.

title: Commission Delegated Directive amending RoHS Annex III: exemption 7(a) for lead in high melting temperature solders expires for categories 1-7
summary: Exemption 7(a) for lead in high melting temperature type solders is renewed only for categories 8, 9 and 11; for other categories the exemption expires 18 months after entry into force.

title: Candidate List updated with three new SVHCs including a brominated flame retardant used in printed circuit boards
summary: ECHA has added three substances of very high concern to the Candidate List. Companies have legal obligations including Article 33 communication and SCIP notification for articles containing the substances above 0.1% w/w.

title: BIS adds 12 entities to the Entity List including two Chinese electronic component manufacturers
summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security amends the Export Administration Regulations by adding entities to the Entity List under the destination of China. A licence requirement applies to all items subject to the EAR. Effective immediately.

title: Factory fire halts production at a Vietnam capacitor plant supplying tantalum capacitors to power-supply makers
summary: A fire at the Bac Ninh facility stopped all lines; the company expects a 6 to 8 week recovery. Customers in the power supply and server industries are assessing alternative sources.

title: Delegated act under the Battery Regulation sets battery passport data requirements for industrial and LMT batteries
summary: The act specifies the data attributes, access rights and technical requirements of the battery passport for lithium-ion industrial batteries above 2 kWh from February 2027.

title: EPA final rule under TSCA requires reporting of PFAS in imported articles including electronics
summary: The final rule requires manufacturers and importers of articles containing PFAS to report uses, volumes and exposures for the 2011-2022 period. Final rule.

title: US CBP expands UFLPA enforcement to polysilicon and aluminium components in electronics; shipments detained at Los Angeles
summary: Customs detentions under the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act now target aluminium housings and polysilicon. Importers must provide supply chain tracing to release goods.

title: 經濟部更新戰略性高科技貨品出口管制清單，新增高效能FPGA與GaN射頻元件
summary: 經濟部國際貿易署公告修正戰略性高科技貨品種類，新增高效能可程式邏輯元件及氮化鎵射頻放大器之輸出許可規定，自公告日起六個月後實施。

title: Implementing regulation on recycled content calculation for plastic packaging under the PPWR
summary: Sets the methodology for calculating and verifying recycled content in plastic packaging, including EPS and PVC, ahead of the 2030 targets.

title: Commission publishes Cyber Resilience Act guidance on SBOM format and vulnerability reporting for connected industrial devices
summary: Draft guidance clarifies the software bill of materials format and the 24-hour reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities for products with digital elements such as gateways and sensors.

title: ECHA committees advance universal PFAS restriction - fluoropolymers and PFAS surfactants in electronics scoped with transition periods
summary: Duplicate report of the ECHA PFAS progress from a second outlet.

summary: Unrelated business news item used to test the relevance filter.
